name: Hassan
bible: A lean, stooped assassin, tall and narrow with a hunched, gliding carriage and shoulders rolled forward. FACE: a smooth bone-white skull mask with carved flat planes at the brow and cheekbones, a long narrow jaw, two deep black eye sockets with a faint teal glow inside, and one hairline crack running from the left socket down to the jaw. HAIR: none visible; a black cowl covers the crown and falls to the shoulders with ragged, torn edges. COSTUME: a close-fitting charcoal-black bodysuit with dark slate-grey leather straps and bracers, and a black belt. A long ragged near-black cloak with grey-tan tattered hems hangs to the knees and streams behind him. WEAPON: a pair of short, slim, slightly curved bone-white knives, each blade no longer than the hand from wrist to fingertip, on short black wrapped grips with no guard. One knife in each hand, usually reverse-grip with the blade running along the forearm. The RIGHT hand is human and holds the right knife. The LEFT hand is a pale, translucent spectral claw of long fingers that closes around the left knife's grip. His spectral energy, claw glow and trails are MINT-TEAL light with white cores.
design:
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right, hunched and slim; a combat stance with both knives reverse-grip; a walking pose; a running pose; a jump; a close-up of the skull mask under the cowl
- middle rows: six attack and special poses: quick stabs, reverse-grip slashes, a low lunge, a downward plunge, the overhead claw sweep, the spectral claw skimming the ground with mint light
- bottom row: guard, hit reaction, knocked down, a victory pose, the Phantom Hand special with its mint claw reaching forward

run.title: Run cycle (8 frames, loops from frame 8 back to frame 1)
frames: run cycle 1: right foot contact, stride long and low, torso pitched far forward and hunched, the right knife held reverse-grip at the hip, cloak streaming behind
run cycle 2: right foot down, body at its lowest, skull tipped forward, cloak lifting off the ground
run cycle 3: passing pose, left knee driving forward, the spectral left claw held low at the side with its knife tucked in
run cycle 4: left leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet briefly off the ground, knives drawn in close
run cycle 5: left foot contact, stride long and low (the mirror of frame 1), torso far forward
run cycle 6: left foot down, body at its lowest, cloak trailing
run cycle 7: passing pose, right knee driving forward, the right knife tucked at the hip, body rising
run cycle 8: right leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet off the ground, claw and knife held in close

atk-a.title: Basic combo strikes 1 and 2: quick reverse-grip knife work (3 frames each)
frames: combo strike 1, anticipation: the right knife pulled back low at the hip in reverse grip, blade along the forearm, body crouched and coiled, the spectral left claw held close to the chest
combo strike 1, strike: a fast straight stab forward with the right knife, arm fully extended, the knife point leading, a short mint trail kept inside this cell
combo strike 1, recovery: the stab withdrawn, the knife snapping back to the hip, weight already shifting forward
combo strike 2, anticipation: the spectral left claw swinging its knife back across the chest, body twisting, reverse grip
combo strike 2, strike: a short reverse-grip slash across the body from the left knife, a sharp mint arc trail kept inside this cell, cloak whipping round
combo strike 2, recovery: both knives drawn back into a low guard, skull tipped forward, settling into a hunched stance

atk-b.title: Combo finisher and aerial attack: lunge and mid-air slash (3 frames each)
frames: combo finisher, anticipation: a deep low crouch, both knives dropped to the sides in forward grip, the spectral claw pulled back behind the hip, weight sinking
combo finisher, strike: a lunging double stab, both knives thrust forward together as he drives off the ground, body stretched flat, a bright mint trail kept inside this cell, the strongest pose
combo finisher, recovery: body fully extended, the cloak flaring out behind, the knives pulled back in, settling low
aerial attack, anticipation: in mid-air, body tucked and hunched, both knives drawn back in reverse grip above the shoulders
aerial attack, strike: a sweeping downward double slash with both knives in reverse grip, a mint arc trail kept inside this cell
aerial attack, recovery: airborne, knees tucked, the knives folded in close, the cloak billowing upward, returning to a ready pose

atk-c.title: Plunge attack and heavy attack: knife dive and claw sweep (3 frames each)
frames: plunge, dive: diving head-first straight down, both knives pointed at the ground in reverse grip, the spectral claw trailing under the body, mint speed lines
plunge, impact: landing in a low crouch, both knives driven into the ground in front, a burst of mint light and dust kept inside this cell
plunge, recovery: rising from the impact, the knives pulled free and drawn back to the sides
heavy attack, charge: body coiled, the spectral claw pulled far back with a glowing mint light building in its palm, the right knife held reverse-grip behind him
heavy attack, strike: a wide overhead sweep of the spectral claw and knife, body rising into the swing, a huge mint arc trail kept inside this cell
heavy attack, follow-through: deep follow-through, the claw dragging low, mint motes dissipating

sheetNotes.idle: Both knives held reverse-grip in front of the body, the spectral left claw loose and slowly curling its fingers; the hunched head tilts slightly between breaths; the cloak sways.
sheetNotes.air: In the air both knives are drawn in reverse-grip; the spectral claw trails below him and the cloak billows upward.
sheetNotes.dash: Ground dash: he flattens into a low glide, the cloak streaming back as a long ragged shape, the spectral claw stretched forward.
sheetNotes.hurt: The skull cannot show an expression: pain shows through the whole head snapping back, the cowl whipping, the mint claw flickering, and the body folding over. Both knives stay in hand.
sheetNotes.art: Phantom Hand: anticipation 1-2, the spectral left claw grows long and pale and reaches low toward the ground, fingers spreading, mint light pooling in its palm. Execution 3-4, the huge translucent claw races along the ground toward the right edge of the cell, fingers closing into a crushing grip, mint light and motes trailing from it, kept inside the cell. Recovery 5-6, the claw dissolves into drifting mint motes as he rises back to a hunched stance.
sheetNotes.misc: Skill throw: the thrown item is a single bone-white knife flicked overhand with the right hand. Taunt: he tilts the skull slowly to one side, the cloak flaring, and beckons with the spectral claw by curling its fingers toward the opponent. Victory: he stands upright with the skull lifted toward the viewer, the right knife turned reverse-grip and held low, the spectral claw slowly opening as if releasing a soul, mint motes drifting around him.
sheetNotes.ko: Intro: he walks in slowly and hunched, the skull tipped to one side, the spectral claw hanging loose; he lifts the claw to the level of the mask, flicks both knives into reverse grip in a fast flourish with mint trails, and settles into the hunched stance. Defeat: the skull's crack widens as he drops to one knee and then falls forward.
